name: SnoCo Has Too Much 3x3 2023
information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SnoCoHasTooMuch3x32023#21634-please-read-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Even though we don't expect this to be an issue, please be aware that depending on the amount of competitors, we might need to change the amount of rounds or amount of competitors that can procceed to future rounds. This is in compliance to regulations [9m](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#9m) and [9p](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#9p)

There will be unofficial 3x3 events at this competition. You can check out the [Extra 3x3 Events](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SnoCohastoomuch3x32023#29280-extra-3x3-events) tab for more info. Some unofficial events will be taking place during lunch time. If we end the unofficial events early, we will start with the afternoon events at 2:00 rather than 2:15.
